issue.title: Flaky test_title_footer_and_chooser_show_effective_and_configured_limits under the full parallel lane
issue.description: tests/test_models_panel_runner_limit.py::test_title_footer_and_chooser_show_effective_and_configured_limits now exceeds the committed flake baseline. It has multiple host-local full-run failure records but passes in a focused rerun on this tree. This task is node-specific; older Models-panel flake tasks are related but cover different tests and assertions.

task_type_fields.evidence: Selection-health gate in monitor q94ckm0f0ap0 (2026-08-23T19:27:53Z-19:47:04Z) named this node as one of three reproducible flakes above tests/reproducible_flake_baseline.txt. Host-local records include 20260815T181758Z-58b9b447fed9-3033273-full-run.json (3 failures), 20260816T004419Z-7d7581a21cc7-1686445-full-run.json (6 failures), several 20260819 full-run records on edf64fa1/a64acb267 noisy dirty trees, and 20260823T192606Z-9615cd639431-3640426-full-run.json (mode cost, one failure). Focused rerun on the current tree passed: .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_models_panel_runner_limit.py::test_title_footer_and_chooser_show_effective_and_configured_limits -q -> 1 passed in 2.86s. This is not caused by the proc shell row polish diff, which touches Agents/proc-shell rendering, not ModelsPanel runner-limit behavior. Serial/focused reproduction is currently negative; failure appears under full-suite or cost-lane conditions.
